articles.summary: DALLAS, Oct. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Strive, Inc. (“Strive” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: ASST), announced today the closing of its upsized initial public offering of 7,000,000 shares of Strive’s 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock (the “SATS Stock”), at a public offering price of $90 per share. The SATS Stock is expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Market on or around October 20, 2026, under the ticker symbol “SATS.” “The successful, upsized IPO of SATS marks a critical milestone in our strategy to maximize long-term total returns for our common equity investors,” said Matt Cole, Chairman and CEO of Strive. “We believe maintaining a high Amplification Ratio is the most important driver of our ability to outperform Bitcoin over time. SATS provides an additional tool to achieve that objective while simultaneously strengthening SATA’s credit profile by adding junior capital beneath it. articles.summary: DALLAS, Oct. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Strive, Inc. (Nasdaq: ASST) (“Strive” or the “Company”) today announced the pricing of its initial public offering (the “offering”) on October 15, 2026 of 7,000,000 shares of Strive’s 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock (the “SATS Stock”), an upsize of 2,000,000 shares over the amount previously announced, at a public offering price of $90 per share.
